answer: Duplicate or cloned identities land in a hollow registry where rewards are zeroed and stakes slashed, so spinning up N sybils costs N times the bond plus forfeiture risk. Honest peers who tend the shared orchard of reputation gain yield proportional to verified work, making the attack economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0086's threat model.
